d: Sandali Booha is an emotional journey of a folk singer Nooraan Noorkotia. There was a time when people used to watch him singing at his Aakhaara. Now he is struggling to earn his bread and butter.
Kujh Keh Nahi Sakde is a comedy film, which revolves around a family which has broken relationships.
A shepherd brings a beautiful bride from Bihar, after which Sardar Jagat Singh, the owner if the sheeps and his wife plans to get shepherd Bhanti's wife married to their son who is mentally ill.
Dararhi is a story of a young girl who is battling through economic and social conditions with her father to struggle for survival.
Daayre showcases a story of a girl who wants to live life of her own choice. The film's story revolves around a character Gurinder, who is an independent girl.
Chup De Bol is a story of a married couple, who have been living lonely lives due to their horrifying past experiences.
Baroohan is a story of a man who moves to USA in order to earn and improve the living standards of his family members.
